selection_note: 2025 holdout is not used to select rules. Pattern at T is evaluated using data through T only; entry is T+1 open. Forward windows containing >15% one-day jumps are excluded as corporate-action-like anomalies.
xianren_note: XIANREN variants are independent quantitative proxies for long-upper-wick / probe behavior; they are not claimed to reproduce any proprietary definition.
